original.statement: Upgrading to Crossplane 2.0 includes an operator step to configure managed resource activation policies, listed as step 3 of the upgrade approach in the official v2 upgrade guide.

decision.reason: The cited excerpt is only a table-of-contents entry [ev-188e63ccea10]. The full step text says Crossplane v2 automatically creates a default MRAP that activates all managed resources (`*`), and that operators can "optionally" replace it with a targeted MRAP for better cluster resource efficiency [ev-06a16cdbc869]. Step 4 also says existing cluster-scoped managed resources keep working unchanged [ev-dd988a5ed5c3]. So no environment needs a migration here, and an exposure of every upgrade from <2.0.0 would flag all upgraders for an optional tuning step, which over-claims mandatory work.
